name: Subject
title: Subject
text: SUBJECT: LEGAL NOTICE CALLING UPON YOU TO {{notice_demand_summary}}, FAILING WHICH LEGAL PROCEEDINGS WILL FOLLOW.

legal_basis.note: The notice must substantially indicate the cause of action and the relief claimed

authoring_note: The subject line does real work: it fixes what the notice is about, and where the addressee is the Government it is part of what Section 80(3) requires the notice to indicate. It should name the demand, not the dispute in the abstract.
